resolved.title: 变量
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

[b][/b]A [b]variable[/b] lets you store a value by assigning it to a name. The name can be used to refer to the value later in the program. 

For example, in game development, you would use a variable to store the points of the player. What’s the point of playing if you don’t know who’s winning right!

To assign a variable, use [b]one equals sign[/b].[code format="py" ]user = "James"  [/code]
[note]In the example above we assigned string "James" to a variable called [b]user[/b].[/note]

resolved.title: 变量名
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variable Names[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Naming your variables is pretty flexible. You can use [b]letters[/b], [b]numbers[/b], and [b]underscores [/b]in variable names. But you [b]can’t[/b] use special symbols, or start the name with a number.
[note]Don’t forget, Python is a case sensitive language. Which means, [b]Lastname [/b]and [b]lastname [/b]are two different variable names.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variable Names[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Naming your variables is pretty flexible. You can use [b]letters[/b], [b]numbers[/b], and [b]underscores [/b]in variable names. But you [b]can’t[/b] use special symbols, or start the name with a number.
[note]Don’t forget, Python is a case sensitive language. Which means, [b]Lastname [/b]and [b]lastname [/b]are two different variable names.[/note]

content.text:
变量名是相当灵活的。你可以使用 **字母** 、**数字** 和 **下划线** 。
但你不能使用其他特殊符号，或以数字开头的名称。
content.text_html:
Naming your variables is pretty flexible. You can use letters, numbers, and **underscores **in variable names. But you can’t use special symbols, or start the name with a number.

命名你的变量是相当灵活的。你可以在变量名称中使用字母、数字和下划线。但你不能*使用特殊符号，或以数字开头的名称。

content.text:
不要忘记，Python是一种区分大小写的语言。
这意味着，**Lastname** 和 **lastname** 是两个不同的变量名。
content.text_html:
Don’t forget, Python is a case sensitive language. Which means, **Lastname **and **lastname **are two different variable names.
